entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I assist you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your full name and order number, please?
Sarah Jenkins. The order is VF554-901.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered on January 8th of this year. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference?
It's a preference. I just changed my mind.
I see. Could you tell me a little more? Sometimes there are features that...
Listen, it was an impulse buy. I thought I would use it, but I don't use it. It's not complicated.
Understood, Sarah. No problem at all. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment, please.
Okay, thank you for holding. I've checked the policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund.
Oh. Fine. I was getting ready to argue or have you tell me to use some kind of resale marketplace. So you're just taking it back?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. And since you're a VIP member with VeloFit, I've also gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for the inconvenience. You can use that on any future purchase.

Perfect. The credit is active immediately. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a great day.
